rewrite.description: Replaced 15-branch if-else priority chain for NextState with 6 direct AND-OR bit equations. Each NextState bit computed as OR of mutually-exclusive contributing terms. Eliminates priority mux depth (O(n) → O(1) for each bit). State decode uses direct bit indexing instead of equality comparison. Input conditions use one-hot guarantee (twenty_active = twenty & ~ten).
rewrite.equivalence_note: All terms per NextState bit are mutually exclusive by construction: one-hot state encoding guarantees exactly one state_is_* is active; one-hot input guarantee (ten ⊕ twenty ⊕ none) guarantees exactly one input condition is active. Priority if-else semantics preserved trivially since no two conditions in an OR can both be true.
